agent.name: Special Dark Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance, contrary evidence and anti-hype qualification

scope_probe.analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
scope_probe.general_et_finding: NOT YET EVALUABLE. Layer 1 stops on an unintegrated component; no system is demonstrated. All six criteria NOT SCORED. Do not substitute all generative AI or a repaired hypothetical system.
scope_probe.application_finding: The chart workflow is proposed and the specified component cannot establish its capability. Local benefit remains unmeasured.
scope_probe.organization_specific_finding: NOT YET EVALUABLE for the specified component. Request an assembled usable system before scoring or assigning a broader agentic-system label. The chart application remains a proposal; adding a hypothetical repair silently would change the unit. Financial permissions and human accountability do not disappear because the technology description is incomplete.

evidence.claim: Apply the sequential course instrument and distinguish facts, case premises and interpretation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0 Chapter 11 sections 11.2 and 11.7; S1-S6 evidence/source_register.json
evidence.evidence_type: Course framework plus bounded original-source packet
evidence.notes: No source establishes chart-review outcomes. Candidate views are supplied analyses, not independent verification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Strongest higher-significance case: scalable delegation could lower expertise barriers and enable dependent applications. Mechanism-level promise is not observed multi-tier dissolution. The strongest lower case is continued reliance on skilled humans and older automation; withholding breakthrough remains a preserved alternative.

The input is a teaching scenario. Same-assistant prompt applications and reused invariant passages are qualitative fixtures, not blinded trials or evidence of reliable deployment. Dated benchmark and human-assistance studies have different units.
scope_probe.confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a narrowly qualified capability interpretation; low confidence in long-range classification and unknown local net benefit. Withhold even breakthrough where comparator evidence cannot support it. Confidence in preserving the significance/adoption boundary is higher than confidence in empirical performance.
scope_probe.value_opportunity_implication: Less routine work could create value if correctly completed work improves after integration, supervision and correction costs. No benefit is measured here. A locally incremental improvement may be worth comparing without a civilizational label.
scope_probe.risk_governance_implication: Overstatement could bypass data permission or accountable release; dismissing capability change could also delay useful learning. These are prospective risks, not observed losses. Preserve reversible work and named human ownership.
scope_probe.recommendation_management_implication: Proposed synthesis: retain a qualified bounded breakthrough interpretation, no endorsed Promethean label, and an explicit withholding alternative. Use broad significance for attention and monitoring, not as adoption authorization. This is not a recorded team endorsement; acceptance remains pending.
change_monitoring_triggers: Analytics owner at the proposed four-week review: compare correctness, total time and cost with manual/deterministic checks. Measured superiority strengthens the local case; no improvement weakens it.

Research owner at the twelve-month review or material new evidence: examine attributable dependence and distinct human-life tiers. Credible dissolution strengthens the higher hypothesis; concentrated, reversible uses weaken it.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request a usable system, explicit comparator and attributable dependence where absent. Unknown is not contradicted; no forced numerical score.
No classroom completion percentage, member verification or team acceptance can be inferred from these files or validators.

incremental_control.analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
incremental_control.general_et_finding: Classification: INCREMENTAL under the closed teaching premises. This usable deterministic system improves formatting within an existing activity. No convincing categorical barrier or substantial capability discontinuity is stipulated. Suppression restores earlier formatting methods. All six criteria NOT SCORED; no Promethean inference.
incremental_control.application_finding: Proposed incremental formatting convenience only; this control is not an observed implementation.
incremental_control.organization_specific_finding: For this closed negative control, ordinary formatting convenience does not justify a strategic classification or adoption command. It can be evaluated on its own modest value, permissions and maintainability. The control does not demonstrate real savings; keep report ownership and do not borrow the agentic-system label.

course_calibration.analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
course_calibration.general_et_finding: Classification: CONFIRMED PROMETHEAN within the supplied S0 retrospective course calibration, not independently validated history. The stipulated integrated infrastructure passes the system and dissolution gates across distinct tiers. Formal qualitative assessment is eligible under those premises: order-of-magnitude change COURSE ANCHOR; widespread impact COURSE ANCHOR; paradigm shift COURSE ANCHOR; catalytic effect COURSE ANCHOR; democratization COURSE ANCHOR; irreversibility COURSE ANCHOR. No numeric score or new historical measurement is asserted. This anchor does not transfer a classification to agentic AI.
course_calibration.application_finding: The proposed chart-review assistant is prospective incremental workflow assistance relative to manual reconciliation and deterministic checks. No implemented benefit, quality advantage, savings or staffing displacement is established. Drafting and tool choice do not remove responsibility for source-grounded interpretation. Benchmark changes are not a tenfold verified chart-review result. A simpler comparator can be useful without any Promethean claim; only an actual matched comparison can establish local value.
course_calibration.organization_specific_finding: The supplied retrospective anchor exercises classification rules only. Its importance supplies no proof about a proposed agentic chart-review tool. Hold that application decision separate and request its own evidence and operating permission; the anchor cannot authorize adoption.
